A2 Key Paper 2 Listening Part 4 – Teacher’s Notes

Description

In this activity students begin by thinking about different conversations they have with friends. They
answer some questions to familiarise themselves with A2 Key Paper 2 Listening Part 4. Finally, they
complete a Part 4 listening task.

Time required:  20–25 minutes
Materials
required:        A2 Key Handbook for Teachers (or sample paper)
                 a set of cards per student or per pair of students
Aims:            Recording of A2 Key Listening sample paper Part 4
                 Follow-up activity (optional)

                 to familiarise students with the content and format of Key Paper 2
                     Listening Part 4

                 to practise listening for detailed understanding

Procedure

    1. Explain to students that they will be doing Part 4 of the A2 Key Paper 2 Listening exam. As a
         lead-in, ask students to work together and think of answers to the following question:
                   What do friends talk about?
          Elicit their ideas including work, shopping, studying, looking at photographs and problems.

    2. Cut up the cards – shopping, studying, photographs, problems – and give a copy to each
         student/pair of students. Tell them they have to listen and hold up the appropriate card to match
         what you are saying. If you have space in your classroom you could put the cards, one on each
         of the walls and as you say a word the students have to run to that card.

         a) cheap (shopping)
         b) history (studying)
         c) train delayed (problem)
         d) a zoo (photograph)
         e) some games (shopping)

    3. Give out the sample test and ask students to underline the key vocabulary in the questions.
         Explain that they will have to listen for paraphrasing so they need to think of different ways of
         saying the key vocabulary. Ask students to work in pairs so you can monitor and hear if they have
         any problems.

Check through the answers (see Answer key).

        4. Explain that you are going to play the recording for the first question (16) of Part 4, stopping
            after they have heard it once. Ask students to compare their answers. Monitor so you can hear
            where they had problems with the answer. Play the recording so they now hear it for a second
            time. Again, allow them to check their answer with their partner. Elicit the answer from the class
            (A). Give out the transcript folded over so that only question 16 is visible and ask students to
            underline where they heard the answer. Go over the other options and ask students to
            underline any words associated with them (see Answer key).

        5. Explain to students that each recording contains words or phrases that might make them think
            that one of the wrong answers is correct, so they need to listen carefully the second time to
            make sure that they hear the right answer.

        6. Before students listen to the rest of the recordings tell them that sometimes they hear two
            speakers, and sometimes only one. Play the rest of the recordings one by one and allow students
            to pair check before they listen the second time round to allow them to peer teach each other and
            you to hear where they have had problems.

        7. Check their answers as a class (see Answer key). Ask students to look through the information
             for the answers in the transcript and to underline it. Check their answers. Play the recording
             again, asking students to listen and read at the same time.

Suggested follow-up activities
       1. Students can roleplay different scenarios making up their own dialogues.

       2. Alternatively, they can use the transcript and change the key vocabulary to make up their own
             dialogue.

       3. If you want the students to practise using the answer sheet, photocopy it and ask the students to fill
             in the lozenges in pencil for their answers to Part 4.

A2 Key Paper 2 Listening Part 4

Look at the Part 4 task below. Underline the key vocabulary in the question.

Questions 16–20

For each question, choose the correct answer.

16. You will hear a woman talking to her friend about why she’s bought a motorbike.
       Why did she buy it?

       A It’s fast.
       B It was cheap.
       C It’ll be easy to repair.

17. You will hear two friends talking about going to university.
       What subject is the man going to study?

       A history
       B geography
       C chemistry

18. You will hear two friends talking about a photograph.
       What’s the photograph of?

       A a sports stadium
       B a zoo
       C a school playground

19. You will hear a woman talking to a friend on the phone.
       Why’s she upset?

       A Her train was delayed.
       B She’s lost her wallet.
       C She’s broken her glasses.

20. You will hear a woman talking to her friend, David, about something she’s bought.
       What has she bought?

       A some clothes
       B some food
       C some games
